a.title: Bound the increment, name owners, baseline
Mandatory for net-new products and journeys
Enterprise, domain, project and engineering context
BRD and PRD from discovery; business, product, architecture approval
Journey design, target architecture, contracts, data, security
Transform approved requirements into traceable work
Improve product, context and agent chain
Conditional: poorly defined or conflicting change
Existing code, architecture, APIs, dependencies, incidents, debt
Reuse approved requirement; clarify, update AC. No BRD/PRD regeneration
Impact analysis, compatibility, reuse, regression risk
Reuse approved backlog and spec where sufficient
Feed production learning back into requirements, tests, context
Conditional: reframe the outcome if required
Analyse source, SME verification, then BRD and PRD
Backlog and spec for the modernisation approach
Legend: ■ mandatory / applies to the path ■ conditional ■ reusable with evidence. Tailoring changes how the lifecycle is traversed, not the requirement for evidence and accountability.
